New Debhi, the 12th July, 2019

RESOLUTION

Itis announced for general information that during the year 2019-2020, accumulations at
the credit of subscribers to the General Provident Fund and other similar funds shall carry
interest at the rate of 7.9% (Seven point nine percent) w.e.f. 1st July, 2019 to 30th September,
2019. This rate will be in force w.e.f. 1st July, 2019. The funds concemed are:

The General Provident Fund (Central Services).
The Contributory Provident Fund (India).

The All India Services Provident Fund.

The State Railway Provident Fund.

The General Provident Fund (Defence Services).
